candidate_data.name_en: South Africa: Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla shares Trump deepfake endorsing MK party for the 2024 vote
candidate_data.description_de: Am 9. März 2024 verbreitete Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, Tochter des Ex-Präsidenten Jacob Zuma und prominente Stimme der neuen uMkhonto-weSizwe-Partei (MK), auf X ein Deepfake-Video, in dem der ehemalige US-Präsident Donald Trump scheinbar alle Südafrikaner:innen aufruft, am 29. candidate_data.description_en: On 9 March 2024, Duduzile Zuma-Sambudla, daughter of former president Jacob Zuma and a prominent voice in the new uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) party, shared on X a deepfake video appearing to show former US president Donald Trump urging all South Africans to vote MK on 29 May. Audio quality was high enough that some users could not identify it as fabricated. South Africa's Financial Sector Conduct Authority also warned in 2024 about deepfake videos of President Cyril Ramaphosa used in fraudulent investment schemes.

candidate_data.name_en: Nigeria: 2024 Cybercrime Amendment Act allows warrantless surveillance — journalist Daniel Ojukwu detained after FIJ corruption reporting
candidate_data.description_de: Am 28. Februar 2024 unterzeichnete Präsident Bola Tinubu den Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, Etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024, der Sicherheitsbehörden in 'dringenden' Fällen die Kommunikationsabhörung ohne Gerichtsbeschluss erlaubt, Telekoms zu längerer Speicherung von Nutzerdaten verpflichtet und 'falsche' oder 'irreführende' Posts kriminalisiert. Am 1. Mai 2024 wurde der investigative Journalist Daniel Ojukwu (26) von der Foundation for Investigative Journalism in Lagos verhaftet, nach Abuja verbracht und neun Tage festgehalten — wegen seiner Berichterstattung über Korruption hochrangiger Beamter. Paradigm Initiative, SERAP, Amnesty International und CPJ haben den Fall dokumentiert; die Gesetzesänderung wurde als verfassungswidrig eingestuft.
candidate_data.description_en: On 28 February 2024 President Bola Tinubu signed the Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, Etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024, which lets security agencies intercept communications without a court order in 'urgent' cases, requires telecoms to retain user data for longer periods and criminalises 'false' or 'misleading' posts. On 1 May 2024, investigative journalist Daniel Ojukwu (26) of the Foundation for Investigative Journalism was arrested in Lagos, transferred to Abuja and held for nine days — over his reporting on corruption among senior officials. Paradigm Initiative, SERAP, Amnesty International and CPJ documented the case; the amendment has been labelled unconstitutional.

candidate_data.description_en: The Justemotions research group published in 2024 in Frontiers in Sociology an ethnographic study of real criminal proceedings and prosecution offices in Italy. The study warns of 'automation bias' and erosion of judicial independence, especially under growing pressure for efficiency.

candidate_data.name_de: USA: Steven Anderegg in Wisconsin — erste DOJ-Anklage wegen KI-generierter CSAM mit Stable Diffusion
candidate_data.name_en: USA: Steven Anderegg in Wisconsin — first DOJ indictment for AI-generated CSAM via Stable Diffusion
candidate_data.description_de: Am 15. Mai 2024 erhob eine Grand Jury im Western District of Wisconsin Anklage gegen Steven Anderegg (42) aus Holmen. Vorwurf: Erzeugung, Verbreitung und Besitz tausender obszöner KI-Darstellungen Minderjähriger mit Stable Diffusion sowie Übermittlung obszönen Materials an einen 15-Jährigen per Instagram-DM. Bei Verurteilung in allen vier Counts drohen bis zu 70 Jahre Haft. Im März 2025 wies ein Bundesrichter einen Besitz-Anklagepunkt unter Berufung auf den First Amendment ab, ließ die übrigen Counts aber stehen. Erster bekannter Bundes-Fall der USA zu rein KI-generiertem CSAM.
candidate_data.description_en: On 15 May 2024 a federal grand jury in the Western District of Wisconsin indicted Steven Anderegg (42) of Holmen for producing, distributing and possessing thousands of obscene AI-generated images of minors via Stable Diffusion and for transferring obscene material to a 15-year-old boy through Instagram direct message. The four counts carry a statutory maximum of 70 years. In March 2025 a federal judge dismissed the possession count on First Amendment grounds but allowed the other counts to proceed. It is the first known US federal prosecution targeting purely AI-generated CSAM.

The incidents fed into broader debate on child protection and prompted calls for a federal investigation against X's Grok chatbot for deepfake material.

candidate_data.name_en: South Korea: Lunit INSIGHT MMG misses 14% of invasive breast cancers in Korean study
candidate_data.description_de: Eine in Radiology veroeffentlichte retrospektive Studie der Korea University College of Medicine analysierte 1.097 invasive Brustkrebsfaelle der Jahre 2014-2020 mit der kommerziellen KI-Mammografie-Software Lunit INSIGHT MMG (Version 1.1.7.3). Die KI verfehlte 14 Prozent (154 von 1.097) der invasiven Krebse - insbesondere bei juengeren Frauen, kleineren Tumoren, dichtem Brustgewebe und Tumoren ausserhalb der Mammazonen. Die luminalen Subtypen wurden in 17,2 Prozent uebersehen. Studie hat unmittelbare Patientensicherheits-Relevanz fuer Screening-Programme in Korea, USA und UK.
candidate_data.description_en: A retrospective study by Korea University College of Medicine, published in Radiology in 2025, analysed 1,097 invasive breast cancer cases from 2014-2020 using the commercial AI mammography software Lunit INSIGHT MMG (version 1.1.7.3). The AI missed 14% (154 of 1,097) of invasive cancers - particularly in younger women, smaller tumours, dense breast tissue, and tumours outside the glandular area. Luminal-subtype cancers were missed in 17.2% of cases. The study has immediate patient-safety relevance for screening programmes in Korea, the US and UK.

candidate_data.name_en: Australia: OAIC preliminary inquiry into I-MED, Harrison.ai and Annalise.ai over disclosure of medical scans for AI training
candidate_data.description_de: Am 20. September 2024 eroeffnete die australische Datenschutzbehoerde OAIC Voruntersuchungen gegen den Radiologieanbieter I-MED, Harrison.ai und Annalise.ai. Anlass waren Medienberichte ueber die Weitergabe privater medizinischer Scans an Dritte fuer das Training eines KI-Modells. Die OAIC pruefte Form und Inhalt der weitergegebenen Patient:innendaten, den Datenfluss und die Anonymisierungsschritte. Im Ergebnis stellte sie fest, dass die Daten ausreichend de-identifiziert waren - der Vorfall wirft jedoch grundsaetzliche Einwilligungs- und Transparenzfragen fuer KI-Training in der australischen Radiologie auf.
candidate_data.description_en: On 20 September 2024, Australia's privacy regulator OAIC opened preliminary inquiries into radiology provider I-MED, Harrison.ai and Annalise.ai after media reports that private medical scans were shared with a third party to train an AI model. OAIC examined the form and content of the patient data, the data flow and the de-identification steps. It ultimately found the data sufficiently de-identified, but the case raised fundamental consent and transparency questions for AI training in Australian radiology.

The precedent for PIPA enforcement against AI systems is highly relevant for health chatbots in Korea.

candidate_data.description_de: Die australische Verbraucherorganisation CHOICE warf Airbnb 2022 vor, mit einem intransparenten Algorithmus zu beurteilen, ob Nutzer 'vertrauenswürdig' seien, und Konten teils ohne Erklärung zu sperren. Das auf dem zugekauften Trooly-Patent beruhende Verfahren wertet öffentlich und privat verfügbare Daten aus, um Persönlichkeits- und Verhaltensmerkmale wie mutmaßlichen Drogen- oder Alkoholkonsum einzuschätzen. Der Bericht reihte sich in internationale Kritik (vgl. EPIC-FTC-Beschwerde 2020) an verdeckter algorithmischer Charakterbewertung ein.
candidate_data.description_en: In 2022 the Australian consumer organisation CHOICE accused Airbnb of using an opaque algorithm to judge whether users are 'trustworthy' and of banning some accounts without explanation. Based on the acquired Trooly patent, the method analyses publicly and privately available data to estimate personality and behavioural traits such as suspected drug or alcohol use. The report added to international criticism (cf. EPIC's 2020 FTC complaint) of covert algorithmic character-scoring.

candidate_data.name_de: USA: LFW-Datensatz missachtet Persönlichkeitsrechte von Internetnutzer:innen
candidate_data.name_en: LFW dataset disregards the privacy rights of internet users
candidate_data.description_de: Der von der University of Massachusetts Amherst aufgebaute Datensatz 'Labeled Faces in the Wild' (LFW) enthält über 13.000 aus dem Netz gesammelte Gesichtsbilder, die ohne ausdrückliche Einwilligung der Abgebildeten erhoben wurden. LFW wurde zu einem Standard-Benchmark für Gesichtserkennung und löste eine Welle ähnlicher, ohne Zustimmung von Plattformen wie Google, YouTube, Flickr und Yahoo News gescrapter Datensätze aus. Kritiker:innen sehen darin ein frühes Muster für den systematischen Verzicht auf Einwilligung bei biometrischen Trainingsdaten.
candidate_data.description_en: The 'Labeled Faces in the Wild' (LFW) dataset, built by the University of Massachusetts Amherst, contains over 13,000 web-collected face images gathered without the explicit consent of those depicted. LFW became a standard benchmark for facial recognition and triggered a wave of similar datasets scraped without consent from platforms such as Google, YouTube, Flickr and Yahoo News. Critics see it as an early template for the systematic disregard of consent in biometric training data.

Von 50.176 zwischen Januar und Mai 2021 ausgewerteten Alarmen ergaben nur 9,1 Prozent Hinweise auf ein Schusswaffendelikt. Das OIG warnte zudem, die Technologie verändere das Verhalten der Polizei gegenüber Menschen in Vierteln mit häufigen Alarmen. Der Bericht wurde zu einem Schlüsseldokument der Debatte um Abschaffung des Systems.
candidate_data.description_en: The City of Chicago Office of Inspector General (OIG) concluded in a report dated August 24, 2021, that ShotSpotter alerts rarely lead to evidence of a gun-related crime. Of 50,176 alerts reviewed between January and May 2021, only 9.1 percent indicated evidence of a gun-related offence. The OIG also warned that the technology changes how police perceive and interact with people in neighbourhoods with frequent alerts. The report became a key document in the debate over discontinuing the system.

In one example, a Star Wars piece on a site called Worldtimetodays was nearly identical to a Distractify article, down to the same author photo. Google said it does not focus on whether an article was written by AI or a human and partly disputed the claims as inaccurate. The case illustrates the opaque, gameable ranking of Google News in the era of generative AI.

With roughly USD 100 billion in deposits withdrawn, First Republic was the biggest casualty of the crisis.

candidate_data.name_en: Global: PimEyes accused of scraping images from social-media platforms
candidate_data.description_de: Seit 2020 berichteten Medien und Datenschützer, dass die Gesichtssuchmaschine PimEyes ihren Bildbestand durch kontinuierliches Abgreifen (Scraping) frei verfügbarer Fotos aus dem Internet aufbaut - einschließlich Aufnahmen von Social-Media-Plattformen, persönlichen Blogs und Nachrichtenseiten. candidate_data.description_en: From 2020 onward, media and privacy advocates reported that the face-search engine PimEyes builds its image database by continuously scraping freely available photos from the internet - including images from social-media platforms, personal blogs, and news sites. Germany's Netzpolitik and others criticised that the early operators had marketed the service as a way to pry into celebrities' lives. After criticism, PimEyes rebranded as a privacy tool. candidate_data.name_de: USA: Rasse-Korrektur im eGFR-Nierenwert benachteiligt Schwarze Patienten
candidate_data.name_en: USA: Race correction in eGFR kidney measure disadvantages Black patients
candidate_data.description_de: Verbreitete klinische Formeln zur Schatzung der Nierenfunktion (eGFR, etwa MDRD und CKD-EPI) enthielten einen Rasse-Koeffizienten, der die Werte fuer Schwarze Patienten um etwa 16 bis 21 Prozent nach oben korrigierte - basierend auf der widerlegten Annahme hoherer Muskelmasse. Dadurch konnte schwere Nierenerkrankung verschleiert und dringend benotigte Transplantationen verzogert werden. Ab Juni 2020 begannen erste US-Kliniken (u.a. an der University of Washington), den Rasse-Modifikator zu entfernen; 2021 folgte die offizielle Empfehlung der Fachgesellschaften.
candidate_data.description_en: Widely used clinical formulas for estimating kidney function (eGFR, e.g. MDRD and CKD-EPI) contained a race coefficient that inflated values for Black patients by roughly 16 to 21 percent - based on the debunked assumption of higher muscle mass. This could mask severe kidney disease and delay urgently needed transplants. From June 2020, leading US health systems (including the University of Washington) began removing the race modifier; in 2021 the professional societies issued an official recommendation to drop it.

actors.name: University of Washington School of Medicine (and US nephrology practice broadly)

sources.title: Abandoning a Race-biased Tool for Kidney Diagnosis
Embedded Bias: The racial consequences of a kidney function test

candidate_data.description_en: Australia's 'Robodebt' system, running from 2016, automatically matched Centrelink records against averaged tax-office income data and issued large numbers of erroneous debt notices to welfare recipients. On 29 May 2020 the government scrapped the scheme and the attorney-general conceded it was unlawful. About 470,000 wrongly raised debts were repaid, and a class-action settlement of roughly AUD 1.2 billion was reached in November 2020.

candidate_data.description_de: Das People-in-Photo-Albums-Dataset (PIPA), urspruenglich von UC Berkeley und Facebook 2015 veroeffentlicht, enthaelt rund 60.000 Bilder von etwa 2.000 Personen, davon 32.518 von Flickr heruntergeladen - mehrheitlich halb-private Aufnahmen von Familienfesten, Hochzeiten und Kindern. candidate_data.description_en: The People in Photo Albums dataset (PIPA), originally released by UC Berkeley and Facebook in 2015, contains around 60,000 images of about 2,000 people, of which 32,518 were downloaded from Flickr - mostly semi-private scenes of family events, weddings and children. Adam Harvey's Exposing.AI project documented in 2019 that the dataset was subsequently used by the Max Planck Institute for Informatics (Saarbruecken), ETH Zurich, SenseTime and China's National University of Defense Technology, well beyond its original purpose. The Creative Commons compliance was also questioned since some licences exclude commercial use.

The Ethereum community pushed through a hard fork in July 2016 that rolled back the transactions and split the chain into Ethereum (post-fork) and Ethereum Classic (pre-fork). A classic smart-contract bug rather than ML/AI in the narrow sense — borderline fit for AIStrikeMap.

candidate_data.description_en: From 1 July 2025 the Ministry of Women and Child Development conditioned Take-Home-Ration distribution under the Supplementary Nutrition Programme on facial recognition in the POSHAN Tracker app plus Aadhaar OTP. By end-2025 only 52.7 percent of eligible beneficiaries had received rations; Jharkhand sat at 58.5 percent. BOOM Live and the Internet Freedom Foundation documented pregnant women going months without food because the system could not match their current face to the Aadhaar photo taken before marriage. The ministry's RTI response disclosed no Data Protection Impact Assessment, no security audit, no exception-handling procedure.

candidate_data.description_en: In early March 2024 Spain's data-protection authority AEPD (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos) ordered Worldcoin to halt its iris-scanning activities in Spain as an emergency measure. Worldcoin allegedly denied data-subjects both the right to erasure and the right to revoke consent — both explicitly required by the GDPR. The suspension was time-limited but legally precedent-setting for other EU DPAs.

candidate_data.description_en: On 14 October 2024 the EU Council formally adopted the Platform Work Directive 2024/2831, published on 11 November and entering into force on 1 December 2024. Member States must transpose by 2 December 2026.

candidate_data.description_en: Australia's Fair Work Legislation Amendment (Closing Loopholes No. 2) Act 2024 created a world-first 'employee-like workers' category for platform workers and, as of 26 August 2024, protects them from unfair algorithmic deactivation. The Fair Work Commission can set minimum standards on pay, safety, consultation when platforms change algorithms, and dispute resolution. A 'Deactivation Code' requires genuine human judgment before deactivation; Uber, DoorDash and the Transport Workers Union concluded an early sector-wide agreement.

candidate_data.description_de: Am 24. Januar 2024 verabschiedete das sri-lankische Parlament mit 108:62 Stimmen den Online Safety Act, in Kraft seit 1. Februar 2024. Die fünfköpfige präsidial ernannte Online Safety Commission kann Inhalte als 'illegal' definieren, Takedowns anordnen und Strafverfolgung empfehlen — ohne richterliche Kontrolle. Die Sri Lanka Professional Web Journalists Association warnt vor Selbstzensur und Site-Schließungen. Global Network Initiative dokumentiert: Meta, Google, X und TikTok verweigerten die Einrichtung der vorgeschriebenen lokalen Büros und 24-Stunden-Takedown-Frist. Die neue NPP-Regierung kündigte im Januar 2026 Änderungen an, ohne die Kommission abzuschaffen.
candidate_data.description_en: On 24 January 2024 the Sri Lankan Parliament passed the Online Safety Act by 108:62 votes; the Act took effect 1 February 2024. The five-member presidentially-appointed Online Safety Commission may declare content 'illegal', order takedowns and recommend prosecutions — without judicial oversight. The Sri Lanka Professional Web Journalists Association warns of self-censorship and outlet closures. The Global Network Initiative documents that Meta, Google, X and TikTok refused to set up the mandated local offices or accept the 24-hour takedown window. The new NPP government announced amendments in January 2026 but has not abolished the Commission.

An Insecure Direct Object Reference flaw let them iterate applicant IDs and view records of more than 64 million job applicants: names, emails, phone numbers, auth tokens — no rate limit, no MFA. McDonald's and Paradox.ai confirmed and patched within hours.
